_doc: Single source of truth for per-package workflows. Every package exposes the same verbs (install, check, test, build); a missing verb means 'nothing to do'. `dependsOn` lists sibling packages whose changes should also trigger this one. `os` is the CI runner.

skills.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s orchestrator-options/client -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s lab-commander/tests -p 'test_*.py'
